name: Meteors
description: Streaks that fall across a container, for a hero or an empty background. They are real DOM positioned from the index, so the server and the browser agree.

angle.description: Direction of travel in degrees. 215 falls toward the lower right.

color.description: Colour of the streaks, any CSS colour. Defaults to the muted text colour.

duration.description: Average seconds for a streak to cross.

isPaused.description: Stops the effect and shows it still.

requirements: Decoration only: the effect is aria-hidden, never takes focus and never blocks the pointer
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion) and inside an rdm-still container, and isPaused stops it too
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Streaks use slow, soft motion and the amount is capped, and isPaused or a Still switch stops them (WCAG 2.2.2)
Hidden entirely for reduced motion and in forced-colors mode
Place it behind content: it fills its container, which needs position: relative and overflow hidden
screenReader: Not announced: the whole layer is hidden from assistive technology

avoid_when: Any place that must stay calm
anti_patterns: Too many streaks, which reads as noise
